column5: The Sun of May carries its face on a closed round disc, with the rays outside it.
The Sun of May carries its face on a closed round disc, with the rays outside it.
The sun's body is a large round disc; the rays are worked into its edge rather than drawn outside it.
The flag depicts sugar cane, which its own symbolism names as one of Guadeloupe's main crops.
